test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

He spent money on his holiday __as if he were__ a millionaire.
solution:
The correct answer is **No Improvement required.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We use **as if** and **as though** to talk about* an imaginary situation* or *a situation that may not be true* but that is likely or possible. As if is more common than as though.
 
• **were **is used instead of **was **in an unreal comparison. 
 
 
• He looks as if he **were **rich.
 
 
 
• So, the sentence is absolutely correct.
 
• Hence, **Option 4 **is the correct answer.
